about.heroTitle: Painting Colors, Baking Joy, Celebrating Families
about.heroLead: elamel was born around a simple kitchen table with the heartfelt belief that the most precious memories happen when hands create art and families gather around wholesome treats.
about.studioTag: A Home for Every Generation • Pottery Studio & Bakery Under One Roof
about.storyHeading: Our Story: From the Kitchen Table to Your Home
about.storyP1: Elamel was born from the meeting of a passion for traditional ceramic craft and the love of wholesome bakery treats. We realized that families were missing engaging screen-free activities that brought kids, parents, and grandparents together.
about.storyP2: We decided to craft smooth bisque pottery with certified non-toxic glazes that anyone can paint at home, paired with artisanal bakery treats that evoke childhood joy.

values.title: The Four Pillars of the Elamel Experience
values.subtitle: Everything we craft is guided by love, safety, and the celebration of family bonds.

safety.title: Purity & Non-Toxicity
safety.desc: 100% lead-free mineral glazes and a strictly peanut-free bakery kitchen for complete peace of mind.

artisan.title: Artistry & Dedication
artisan.desc: Velvety bisque pottery and pure butter recipes prepared with passion and meticulous detail.

inclusivity.title: Intergenerational Design
inclusivity.desc: Ergonomic brushes and shapes crafted for little hands and grandparents to share moments effortlessly.

joy.title: Cherished Moments
joy.desc: Objects and flavors that transform an afternoon at home into a treasured family memory to keep forever.

about.safetyLead: Parental peace of mind is our highest priority. Every detail of production is designed for child safety.
about.safetyPoint1Desc: Certified under the strictest European toy safety and food contact directives.
about.safetyPoint2Desc: Our kitchen operates under strict segregation protocols to eliminate allergen cross-contamination.
about.safetyPoint3Desc: Mugs and tableware molded with comfortable grips for both toddlers and elderly hands.
